summary: Frontend-only verification of the new TeamNest.ai marketing website (Home / Pricing / Product / Changelog) + relocated auth (/login, /signup). 21 review items exercised via Playwright on https://nest-app-prep.preview.emergentagent.com. All 21 PASS. No functional bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js routes are correct: / -> WebHome (WebLayout), /pricing /product /changelog under WebLayout, /login /signup outside WebLayout (Auth.jsx uses its own two-column layout). The old Landing component is no longer mounted at /. Catch-all '*' redirects to '/' which is now the marketing home — good.

WebNav.jsx correctly conditions on useAuth().user: renders 'Open app →' (web-nav-open-app) when authed, else Log in + Try the demo. Hamburger appears <lg (1024px) and opens a full-screen sheet (fixed inset-0 z-50) — verified at 390px viewport with bbox 390x844.
WebThemeContext applies CSS vars on documentElement: --w-bg flips from #FAFAF7 (light) to #0A0A0E (dark) on toggle, and the choice persists across navigation via localStorage 'tn-theme'.

Pricing.jsx: monthly/annual toggle works ($20→$200/yr Pro, $50→$500/user/yr Team). 4 plan cards render. 'Most popular' badge appears on Team. Credit-cost accordion + FAQ accordion (one-at-a-time) both verified via aria-expanded.
Product.jsx: all 6 anchor IDs present (#chat, #ai-compare, #tasks, #calls, #folders, #integrations). Clicking 'Compare AIs' nav link updates URL hash to #ai-compare.
Changelog.jsx: 5 unique version tags rendered (v1.1–v1.5), 5 date pills, and all three Type pill labels (New / Improved / Fixed) appear in body.

Auth.jsx: two-column layout confirmed (product surface left with 'Chats' panel, form right with 'Welcome back'/'Create account'). /login?demo=1 auto-triggers demo login and lands on /chats. Email login (amit@demo.team / Demo@2026) -> /chats. New signup (unique email) -> /chats. Submit button text is 'Sign in' (not 'Log in') — visible label in screenshot. Spec said 'Email login via /login form' so this is fine; just noting label.
Footer.jsx: 4 columns rendered (brand+tagline + Product + Company + Legal). /privacy, /terms, /support, /downloads all return 200.

lib/api.js public-path whitelist works: marketing pages render even when logged out (401 from /api/me is intercepted but does NOT redirect away from / /pricing /product /changelog /login /signup — confirmed by direct navigation while clearing cookies). The 401 console errors on those pages are expected (whitelisted, non-redirecting).

POLISH suggestion (non-blocking): Home page TrustLine still says 'Built by Emergent · Trusted by teams shipping fast' — the screenshot confirms this is rendered tastefully without fabricated logos. Brief said no fabricated content — good.

POLISH suggestion (non-blocking): Footer 'Company' column has Blog -> /changelog and About -> /product. If a real blog/about page is desired later, route stubs needed; for now the redirect is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created one signup account with email pattern TEST_new{timestamp}@example.com (Test User / Test@2026Pwd). Safe to ignore; prefixed TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 fully validates the new marketing site at / /pricing /product /changelog and the relocated auth at /login /signup. Key data-testids in use: web-hero-headline, web-nav-logo, web-nav-product, web-nav-pricing, web-nav-compare-ais, web-nav-changelog, web-nav-login, web-nav-try-demo, web-nav-open-app, web-nav-hamburger, web-mobile-sheet, web-mobile-sheet-close, theme-toggle, pricing-toggle-monthly, pricing-toggle-annual, web-pricing-cta, web-pricing-teaser-link, web-final-cta-demo, web-hero-try-demo, web-hero-see-pricing, faq-row-{0..5}, auth-name-input. The login submit button label is 'Sign in' (not 'Log in') — selectors should target it accordingly.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Initial test selector misses (button name 'Log in' vs 'Sign in', input[name=name] vs data-testid auth-name-input, text-content match for FAQ) were resolved on re-run with correct selectors and all asserted PASS.
